raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "when"
  role object "since when"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@q query
  select ?t
  measure start
  where match
    relation "look after"
    role subject "Ionuț"
    role object "the payroll database"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
